label: Repo: Bash syntax
command: bash -n scripts/*.sh config/hypr/gpu-env.sh config/hypr/switch-theme.sh config/hypr/start-mpvpaper.sh config/vlc/vlc-open config/ghostty/ghostty-theme.sh config/clamav/scan-targets.sh config/croft/croft-launch.sh config/ox/ox-theme.sh config/ox/ox-launch.sh config/neomacs/neomacs-launch.sh

label: Repo: JSON validation
command: set -e; for f in config/swaync/config.json config/zed/settings.json config/zed/keymap.json; do sed '/^\/\//d' "$f" | jq empty; done; sed '/^\/\//d' config/wlogout/layout | jq -s empty

label: Repo: Theme contract
command: set -e; for d in config/hypr/themes/*/; do for f in colors-waybar.css colors-rofi.rasi colors-wal.vim colors.el colors.sh colors-zed.json colors-hyprland.conf colors-neomutt.muttrc; do test -f "$d$f"; done; done; for f in colors-waybar.css colors-rofi.rasi colors-wal.vim colors.el colors.sh colors-zed.json colors-hyprland.conf colors-neomutt.muttrc; do grep -q "$f" config/hypr/switch-theme.sh; done

label: Repo: Full lint
command: bash -c 'set -e; bash -n scripts/*.sh config/hypr/gpu-env.sh config/hypr/switch-theme.sh config/hypr/start-mpvpaper.sh config/vlc/vlc-open config/ghostty/ghostty-theme.sh config/clamav/scan-targets.sh config/croft/croft-launch.sh config/ox/ox-theme.sh config/ox/ox-launch.sh config/neomacs/neomacs-launch.sh; for f in config/swaync/config.json config/zed/settings.json config/zed/keymap.json; do sed "/^\/\//d" "$f" | jq empty; done; sed "/^\/\//d" config/wlogout/layout | jq -s empty; g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -fsyntax-only config/rofi/keybind-menu.cpp; git diff --check'
